question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **magnificent**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the proper meaning of these given words. 
 
 
• 'Magnificent' means extremely impressive and attractive.
 
• 'Malicious' means having or showing a desire to cause harm to someone.
 
• 'Melodious' means pleasant to listen to, like music.
 
• 'Majority' means the largest number or part of a group of people or things.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, '**magnificent**' should be used because this adjective is used to describe nouns. (bears, wolves, eagles, cranes and swans)

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete passage: *Finland is a country of vast green forests, beautiful Baltic islands, windswept Arctic mountains and (1) countless __blue lakes. These pristine and picturesque landscapes (2) __provide __a habitat for many wild animals and birds including **(3) *****__magnificent __***bears, wolves, eagles, cranes and swans, as well as (4) _______ world’s rarest seals. Birdwatchers flock to Finland to find (5) ________ that are hard to spot anywhere else in Europe. Keen wildlife photographers (6)_______ come here to enjoy excursions and facilities that enable (7) ________ to get spectacular shots of the amazing animals in their (8) _______ settings. Some of the great places to preserve these (9) ________ include Finland’s forty national parks, which are open to (10) _______ all year round.*
